en: A black‑and‑white vintage street view of a small rural town with wooden houses on both sides of an unpaved road. On the left are two-story timber buildings with fenced verandas; a hanging sign reads "CAFÉ." Several people, including women in long dresses and children, stand along the fence, and a dog is visible near the foreground. The road recedes into the distance, lined with wooden fences and trees. Printed at the top right is the caption "Alby – Järnvägsgatan." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
